svg.title: Deterministic row summation
svg.desc: Block term i of a row (Q8_0: one per 32 weights, Q4_K: one per 256) is added to partial p_(i mod 16); the 16 partials start at +0.0 for every row. The row result y is the fixed tree16 sum: level 1 adds p0+p1 ... p14+p15, then 4, 2 and 1 fadds, pairs taken from the left. The gather writes y_out = y, or with the MVM's ACC flag y_out = y_old + y, to lane n mod 16 of SPM line dst + t*stride + n/16.
